state:
Goal `core-sse-and-2-more`. `Core\Sse::current` and `Core\Sse::retry` have all their feature proofs on
disk: `about.md` and three examples each under `docs/examples/core/Sse/`, one attack each under
`tests/hostile/core/Sse/`, one bench each under `benches/members/core/Sse/`, a Rust `#[test]` with a
`covers:` marker in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs`, and `Core\Sse`'s class card (removed from
`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`). `Core\Sse::receive` is the one member left, and it was skipped this
session because no harness can run it: `nvs run` has `--peer` for a WebSocket connection isolate and
nothing that runs a program as the isolate `Core\Sse::upgrade` opens (`EventStreamDoor::Connection`),
so every `receive` call outside a `#[test]` throws `LogicError`.

next.title: `Core\Sse::receive`, and the run mode its examples need

items.text: **A run mode for an event-stream connection** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs` needs examples that run: add a sibling of the `.nvsp` peer file (`crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:2561` reads it, `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:2781` connects it, `crates/nvs-cli/src/peer.rs:1` is the format) that starts the program as a connection isolate with a body stream and the door marked `EventStreamDoor::Connection`, publishes the file's topic values, then ends the stream so `receive()` returns `null`. Document it in `docs/examples/README.md` beside § *A WebSocket peer*. If that is larger than a slice, record a gap under `data/gaps/nvs-cli/` and mark the proofs.

**`Core\Sse::receive` proofs** — examples, hostile, bench, and a `covers:` marker on `a_published_value_reaches_a_subscribed_event_stream_as_a_message` near `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:1290`; the member is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:778`. Its help also needs `Core\Sse\Message`'s class card (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5282`); model it on `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/socket.rs:538`.

backlog: `Core\Sse::upgrade`, `stream` and `send` have no examples, attacks or benches either; they are not in this goal's list, so `bun nv proofs --owed` is where they show up.
The pack's `[context] modules` had only `sse.rs` and `storage.rs`; `crates/nvs-cli/src/peer.rs` is added now.
